verdicts.reason: The two candidates are pixel-identical. In both, the stained-glass window is blown up to fill most of the canvas, so it looks soft and pixelated, and the cross bar has a stray white sliver on its right edge. The headline is small next to the huge window. The date/address block is tiny fine print stranded at the bottom with a ragged alignment that doesn't match the left-aligned headline, which leaves dead space between the window and the details.
